# Tactical map
The tablet shows a pre-rendered snapshot of the battlefield with [color=#a4885c]fog of war[/color], allied positions and capture point status. It's your main tool for coordinating the team.
## How it works - Click the tablet in your hand to open the map window. - [color=#a4885c]Fog of war[/color]: the map only opens where your allies stand. Move as a group — the fog recedes ahead of you, revealing enemy positions. - [color=#a4885c]Allied markers[/color] are tinted with your faction's color — gold for Imperium, dark red for Heretics. - [color=#a4885c]Capture points[/color] show a progress bar, callsign and owner — you see at a glance whose point it is and how capture is going.
## Annotations (officer tablet) The officer tablet can draw on the map: - [color=#a4885c]Brush[/color] — draw lines and marks. - [color=#a4885c]Eraser[/color] — erase. - The whole team sees the annotations — mark enemy points and danger directions before a push. - There are sensible limits on stroke and point counts — draw for a reason, don't paint over the whole map.
## Updates - Fog of war opens several times a second. - Allied markers and points update often. - By default the map snapshot is static — live refresh is off for performance.
## Tips - Keep the tablet in your pocket and open it before a push — orient yourself on where the enemy and your allies are. - Move as a group so the fog of war recedes faster. - Officer: mark enemy points and attack directions for the team before advancing.
